        About

        Tabular Recipe Notation draws a recipe as a dependency tree. Michael Chu popularised it on Cooking For Engineers.

        • Ingredients run down the left column.
        • Each operation sits to the right of everything it acts on and spans those rows. Left to right is the order of work; top to bottom shows what gets combined.
        • Setup that applies to the whole recipe, such as preheating the oven, spans the full width at the top.

        How the converter reads a recipe

        1. It splits the text into a title, ingredients (amount, name, note, group) and steps. English and Chinese units, Markdown, numbered lists and inline lists like “原料：鸡蛋2个，番茄1个” all work.
        2. For each step it finds the ingredients mentioned, including other spellings and group words like “the spices” or 所有调料.
        3. It decides whether the step continues the current dish or starts a new one, and labels it briefly, such as “bake 400°F 20 min” or “翻炒 中火 3分钟”.
        4. Seasonings used in the steps but missing from the list are marked *. Ingredients the steps never mention go last, marked ?.
        5. Tables and ingredient lists translate between English and Chinese with a built-in cooking glossary. Step sentences stay in their original language. Hover a translated cell to see the original.

        关于

        表格化菜谱（TRN）把菜谱画成一张依赖树表格，由 Michael Chu 在 Cooking For Engineers 推广。

        • 最左列是食材。
        • 每个操作位于它所处理的食材右侧，并跨越这些行。从左往右是操作顺序，从上往下能看出哪些东西被合在一起。
        • “预热烤箱”这类全局准备放在表格顶部，横跨整行。

        转换器如何读菜谱

        1. 把文本拆成标题、食材（用量、名称、备注、分组）和步骤。支持中英文单位、Markdown、编号列表和“原料：鸡蛋2个，番茄1个”这样的写法。
        2. 在每一步中找出提到的食材，包括不同写法和“所有调料”“the spices”这类统称。
        3. 判断这一步是在继续当前的菜还是另起一个部分，并生成简短标签，如“翻炒 中火 3分钟”。
        4. 步骤中用到但食材表里没有的调料标 *；步骤中未提到的食材放在最后，标 ?。
        5. 表格和食材表通过内置烹饪词典在中英文之间翻译，步骤原句保持原文。鼠标悬停在翻译过的格子上可看原文。
